task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to make an effort to venture south. After that, try to take a trip west. Then, make an attempt to take a trip north. Next, pick-up the sandwich from the floor of the dish-pit. That's it!
description:
Well I'll be, you are in the place we're calling the canteen.



You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an unblocked exit to the south.

thought: I should go south as the first objective is to venture south.
feedback:
